items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: like Happy Schilling's band, and my brother played with him sometimes

ctx.x: Yeah, you were just a kid.

I was just a kid, see. Attention to the Bull. And at that time, I wasn't, I was just listening to the sound, not the names of the guys. Yeah, you didn't know them, right? See, I didn't know any of them. Just like, well, the only band that I remember that would be brass bands, like Happy Schilling's band, and my brother played with him sometimes, see, when Frisco, the regular drummer, he was, he was sick or something like that, my brother worked with him up there at the fairgrounds, see. But, uh, that was, that…
You ever go to the PNM barbecue, I guess the name ever was?
